title: Racing Gears Advance
sources: own knowledge of the game (written in our own words)

widgets.text:
Position, lap, damage; weapons
Combat racing from Orbital Media: race well and use weapons to earn prize money
Cars take damage; a wrecked car loses time, so armor upgrades matter as much as speed

Front weapons fire ahead (missiles, guns); rear weapons are dropped behind (mines, oil)
Spend money between races; upgrades carry over to later championships
Better cars unlock as you win; a fully tuned early car can still win early cups

Front and rear weapons; use them in packs
Hold front weapons for the straights where rivals line up ahead of you
Drop rear weapons on narrow sections and just before corners
Lap traffic carefully: a hit from behind costs more than a lost place

Championship tracks across several locales
Championships are grouped by difficulty; each one is a series of tracks with points per finish
Learn the shortcuts in practice before racing the cup

Money from races buys upgrades and new cars
Prize money depends on your finishing position in each race
Weapons are bought as upgrades, not picked up on track

Cars and tracks
New cars, weapons and tracks are unlocked by winning championships
Time trial records are kept per track

Championships won
Win every championship at every difficulty for the full set of unlocks
Points decide the championship: consistent podiums beat one lucky win
